AnnouncementResponse.description: One active operator announcement, as displayed by the web banner.

endsAt.description: End of the display window; `null` = open-ended.

id.description: Storage identity — the client's dismiss-cookie key.

AnnouncementSeverityResponse.description: How prominently an announcement is shown.

EmbeddedTokenResponse.description: A token, embedded in another resource's response.

logoUri.description: Logo URI as returned by DAS. May be an `ipfs://` URI.

mint.description:
SPL mint address, base58. `null` until the pool's mints are
resolved by yog-context.

name.description:
Display name (e.g. "USD Coin"). `null` for the same reason
as `symbol`.

oneOf.description:
Latest known price observation, or `null` when the token has
never been priced.

symbol.description: Symbol (e.g. "USDC"). `null` when DAS returned no metadata.

FeeTierResponse.description:
One option of the pools fee filter: a base-fee tier and how many pools carry
it. The list holds the most common tiers only, ascending by fee.

FreshnessStatusResponse.description: How recent the last indexed event is.

LastEventKindResponse.description: The kind of the event that last changed the pool's state.

LiquidityEventKindResponse.description: Whether liquidity went into the pool or out of it.

oneOf.description:
Trade-time USD value of the event (both legs valued at the price
as-of the event). `null` when not computable (a leg unpriced, or
unresolved mints/decimals). `Decimal` → a string, like the other USD.

MeteoraDammV2PropertiesResponse.description: DAMM v2-only pool properties (baseline §8's satellite table).

baseFeeKind.description:
How the base fee behaves over time, from the on-chain account. `None`
while the pool is unresolved, or for a `BaseFeeMode` this crate does not map.

oneOf.description:
The base fee in force right now, in bps; `feeBps` is the genesis tier, the
top of a decaying curve. `None` without a time scheduler (constant fee,
market-cap scheduler, rate limiter), for an unresolved or slot-activated pool.

feeSchedulerExpired.description:
Whether the decay has finished — `currentFeeBps` will not move again.
`None` under the same conditions as `currentFeeBps`.
⚠️ A zero `period_frequency` stays at its cliff while reporting finished;
cp-amm's `validate` makes it unreachable on chain.

hasDynamicFee.description: Whether a volatility-based dynamic fee sits on top of the base fee.

protocolFeePercent.description:
Fee-split percents (0..=100) from the on-chain pool account: Meteora's
cut and a referrer's cut of the trading fee.

MeteoraDlmmPropertiesResponse.description:
DLMM-only pool properties. All six come from one read of the `LbPair`
account: present together for a resolved pool, absent together otherwise.

baseFactor.description:
The two other inputs to the pool's base fee, served raw so a client can
recompute `feeBps` rather than trust it: `baseFactor × binStep ×
10^baseFeePowerFactor / 10_000`.

binStep.description:
Price increment between adjacent bins, in basis points: bin `i` sits at
`(1 + binStep / 10_000)^i`. The defining property of a DLMM pool.

maxVolatilityAccumulator.description:
Per-pool ceiling on the volatility accumulator, and so on how far the
variable fee can climb.

protocolShare.description:
Meteora's cut of the trading fee, in **basis points** — not the whole
percent DAMM v2's `protocolFeePercent` uses. The two are not comparable
without scaling.

variableFeeControl.description:
Magnitude of the volatility-driven fee charged on top of the base fee.
**Zero means no dynamic fee** — DLMM has no boolean flag, unlike DAMM
v2's `hasDynamicFee`.

NetworkStatusResponse.description:
Where the chain is (slot, probe latency) and whether ingestion keeps up. The
two fail apart: the probe's endpoint is not the one ingestion uses.

lastEventAt.description:
Timestamp of the most recent indexed event, if any. `null`
when the database holds no events yet.

observedAt.description: When the probe recorded the slot above.

rpcLatencyMs.description:
Round-trip latency of the probe's last `getSlot` call, in ms — the
distance to *that* endpoint, not to the one ingestion uses.

slot.description: Latest Solana slot the probe saw.

PageResponse_LiquidityEventResponse.description:
The envelope of every paginated response. `nextCursor`/`prevCursor` are
opaque, `null` at their boundary; `isFirst`/`isLast` are not redundant with
them — a single page has both cursors `null` and both flags `true`.

oneOf.description:
Trade-time USD value of the event (both legs valued at the price
as-of the event). `null` when not computable (a leg unpriced, or
unresolved mints/decimals). `Decimal` → a string, like the other USD.

PageResponse_PoolResponse.description:
The envelope of every paginated response. `nextCursor`/`prevCursor` are
opaque, `null` at their boundary; `isFirst`/`isLast` are not redundant with
them — a single page has both cursors `null` and both flags `true`.

items.description:
A pool in API responses. A 24h USD figure skips the hours it cannot value:
`swapBucketsPriced24h` of `swapBuckets24h` says how much of the window it
covers.

oneOf.description:
Realized fee rate over the 24h window, in bps (`fees / volume × 10 000`), of
the hours that could be valued; `None` when volume is absent or zero.
⚠️ Not clipped by the coverage: fees and volume are lost on the same buckets.

Base trading fee in basis points (the genesis tier). `None` while the pool
is unresolved.

Realized trading fee over the last 24h (USD); its three shares below sum
back to it exactly, and are `None` together with it.
⚠️ `lpFees24hUsd` is not `fees − protocol`: cp-amm takes the referral out
of the protocol share. All four are read from the analytics.

signals24h.description:
The pool's signals over the last 24h, newest first, capped per pool. Empty
when the pool was quiet.

swapBuckets24h.description:
Coverage of the volume and fee figures, not `tvlUsd`: hours of the window
with at least one swap, and how many could be valued. Equal values mean
full coverage.

PageResponse_SignalResponse.description:
The envelope of every paginated response. `nextCursor`/`prevCursor` are
opaque, `null` at their boundary; `isFirst`/`isLast` are not redundant with
them — a single page has both cursors `null` and both flags `true`.

items.description:
`GET /api/signals` item (and `GET /api/signals/stream` event — both
endpoints emit exactly this object).

id.description:
Storage identity — stable across pages, usable as a client-side
list key. Emitted as a JSON number: signals are sparse, the
sequence will never approach 2^53.

tokenA.description:
The pool's token pair: every field nullable until yog-context resolves
the pool.

PageResponse_SwapEventResponse.description:
The envelope of every paginated response. `nextCursor`/`prevCursor` are
opaque, `null` at their boundary; `isFirst`/`isLast` are not redundant with
them — a single page has both cursors `null` and both flags `true`.

PoolCurrentStateResponse.description:
The latest observed state of a pool. There is no liquidity `L` here: the
per-movement liquidity is on `/liquidity-events`, beside the kind that signs it.

oneOf.description: Q64.64 fixed-point; encoded as a string to keep precision in JS.

Units of token B per token A, decimal-adjusted, from `last_sqrt_price`: the
concentrated-liquidity price, not the reserve ratio. `None` without a
`sqrt_price` or with unresolved decimals.

PoolDetailResponse.description:
The pool detail sheet: [`PoolResponse`] flattened, plus the properties of the
pool's own protocol under its name. `None` when the pool has no satellite row
yet: discovered, not enriched by yog-context.

PoolPageResponse_PoolResponse.description:
The page envelope, flattened, plus `asOf` — the instant the traversal is
anchored to, `null` on an immutable sort — and `touchedSince`, an upper bound
on the pools active since `asOf` (see `crates/api/README.md`).

ProblemDetailsResponse.description:
RFC 9457 Problem Details, the body of every error response. `type` is
`"about:blank"` until specific problem types exist, so clients branch on
`title`; `instance` is omitted, the client knows the path.

StatsResponse.description:
Protocol-wide totals. Each USD sum comes with its coverage: `poolsPriced` of
`poolsObserved` for the TVL, `swapBucketsPriced24h` of `swapBuckets24h` for
volume and fees, since a sum skips what it cannot value.
